bio.text: Robert G. Burke won the 2026 Republican primary for Massachusetts's 8th Congressional District with no opponent.
He was raised in Milton, Massachusetts, and, according to his campaign website, describes himself as an amateur journalist and videographer.
Boston.com reported in October 2024 that he had also run for the same seat in 2022, against Rep. Stephen Lynch.

sources.title: Meet Robert Burke, the Republican challenging Rep. Stephen Lynch in District 8
